=== extended instructions between rows
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	pushm.a #2, r10
	.loc 1 4 0
	movx.a #0x12345, r10
	.loc 1 5 0
	rpt #4
	rrax.a r10
	.loc 1 6 0
	calla #g
	popm.a #2, r11
	reta
=== address instructions with -g | -g
	.text
	mova #0x12345, r12
	adda r12, r13
	calla r13
	reta
=== the repeat prefix with -g | -g
	.text
f:	rpt #4
	rrax.a r12
	rpt r5 { rlax r13
	jmp f
	reta
